name: studio_accept_job_delivery
description: Buyer accepts delivered work — releases escrow to platform/seller payout.

name: studio_add_comment
description: Add a comment (or reply) on a public post.

name: studio_add_peer_note
description: Add a private note about a peer. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_admin_approve_listing
description: Admin: approve a pending stock listing.

name: studio_admin_decide_seller
description: Admin: approve | reject | suspend a seller. Reject requires reason.

name: studio_admin_get_seller_application
description: Admin: get one seller application with signed KYC document URLs.

name: studio_admin_list_asset_submissions
description: Admin: list stock-audio listing submissions.

name: studio_admin_list_jobs
description: Admin: list hire jobs (booked offers).

name: studio_admin_list_offers
description: Admin: list marketplace offers.

name: studio_admin_list_payouts
description: Admin: list seller payouts (owed/paid).

name: studio_admin_list_sellers
description: Admin: list seller applications. Optional status filter.

name: studio_admin_mark_payout_paid
description: Admin: mark a seller payout as paid (manual bank transfer).

name: studio_admin_refund_job
description: Admin: refund escrow on a job (delivered/in_progress/in_escrow).

name: studio_admin_reject_listing
description: Admin: reject a pending stock listing (reason required).

name: studio_admin_remove_listing
description: Admin: remove a listing and profit-ban it.

name: studio_admin_set_offer_status
description: Admin: set offer status to paused | published | archived.

name: studio_approve_brief
description: Approve a review_ready brief and start generation. Returns jobId / documentId / elementId. Requires generate scope.

name: studio_block_peer
description: Block a peer (they cannot DM you). Requires messages scope.

name: studio_book_offer
description: Book a published offer — holds payment in escrow and starts the job. Requires marketplace scope + balance.

name: studio_bootstrap
description: [preferred] Start here. One-shot: account/credits + workspace tree + agent start-here hints. Optionally pass folderId or path for project_context. Replaces separate health + tree + BFS list_folders.

name: studio_browse_network_listings
description: Browse listed Creative Network stock audio (music/sfx).

name: studio_build_style_sheet
description: Build Style Sheet visual board. Retired from Agent Mode.

name: studio_bulk_move
description: Move up to 50 assets/documents/elements/folders into targetFolderId. Args: {targetFolderId, items:[{kind,id}]}. Prefer when user says move/put/place.

name: studio_cancel_job
description: Cancel a job before delivery (buyer or seller) — refunds escrow.

name: studio_cancel_seller_request
description: Withdraw a pending seller application (before admin approval).

name: studio_change_username
description: Rename the owner's public username (profile must already exist).

name: studio_check_username_available
description: Check whether a username can be claimed/changed by the API key owner.

name: studio_claim_username
description: Claim or set the owner's public username (creates profile if missing).

name: studio_commit_list_on_network
description: Step 3 of listing stock audio: commit listing after Bunny copy is ready. Use fields returned from prepare (+ copy).

name: studio_commit_seller_doc_upload
description: Promote a staged KYC blob to Bunny. Returns { bunnyPath } for studio_request_seller_access.

name: studio_complete_upload
description: Step 2 of two-step upload. Pass assetId from studio_reserve_upload and storageId from the uploadUrl response.

name: studio_create_dm_label
description: Create a DM label. icon must be a known Lucide-style slug (tag, heart, star, …). Requires messages scope.

name: studio_create_document
description: Create a markdown document in a folder. Requires write scope.

name: studio_create_edit
description: [preferred] Create a video edit project. Pass assetIds to seed sequential clips on the timeline (video/image on track-v1, audio on audio tracks). Before cutting: studio_pull_frames on each source (startSec/endSec/count). Keep source audio unless user asks mute (do NOT set effects.volume 0 by default). Open editor live-syncs MCP writes — still prefer studio_get_edit after big replaces.

name: studio_create_element
description: Create a .element (unique @name). Attach one image or video with referenceAssetIds after upload. Tag @name in prompts and element://id in ## References so paste hydrates. Pass referenceElementIds on generate.

name: studio_create_folder
description: Create a single folder. For nested paths prefer studio_ensure_path. Requires write scope.

name: studio_create_offer
description: Create a draft Creative Network offer. Requires approved seller + marketplace write scope.

name: studio_create_style_sheet
description: Create Style Sheet element. Retired from Agent Mode.

name: studio_credit_balance
description: Alias of studio_health — account info + credit balance.

name: studio_decide_assistance_approval
description: Approve or deny a workspace side-effect approval (trash/move/element_build).

name: studio_delete_comment
description: Delete a comment (author or post owner).

name: studio_delete_dm_label
description: Delete a DM label and its memberships. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_delete_message
description: Delete a DM. scope=me hides for you only; scope=everyone (sender only) tombstones for both. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_delete_peer_note
description: Delete a private peer note. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_deliver_job
description: Seller delivers assetIds for a job (moves status to delivered).

name: studio_download_clip_segment
description: [preferred] Download a trimmed clip segment (Save as video/audio). Prefer clipId on a project; or pass assetId + trimIn + trimOut. Returns short-lived { url, filename, contentType }. Requires generate scope.

name: studio_download_edit_package
description: [preferred] Portable .studio package manifest for a video edit (project.json + signed media URLs + icon). Same payload the Files/Export UI zips client-side. Optional expiresUnix (default ~1h).

name: studio_duplicate_asset
description: Duplicate an asset (same Bunny bytes, new row). Optional target folderId and name. Requires write scope.

name: studio_edit_add_text
description: [preferred] Add a title/text overlay clip. Creates a Title track if needed. Patch text later via studio_edit_update_clips.

name: studio_edit_append_clips
description: [preferred] Append image/video/audio clips to an edit. Pass assetIds for simple sequential append, or clips[] for trim/start/track control.

name: studio_edit_apply_text_preset
description: [preferred] Apply a built-in text style template by id (from studio_list_text_presets). Pass clipId to restyle an existing text clip, or omit clipId to add a new text clip with that look. Optional text overrides the caption body.

name: studio_edit_brief
description: Patch assisted brief content fields (subject, objective, keyMessage, production, notes, etc.). Requires expectedRevision. Prefer studio_patch_brief_production for production-only knobs.

name: studio_edit_detach_audio
description: CapCut-style: mute the video clip and add a synced audio bed from the same asset.

name: studio_edit_duplicate_clip
description: Duplicate a clip immediately after it on the same track.

name: studio_edit_message
description: Edit your own text DM or photo caption. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_edit_remove_clips
description: Remove clips by id. Set ripple=true to close gaps on the same track.

name: studio_edit_reorder_clips
description: Reorder all clips on a track. clipIds must list every clip on that track exactly once; startTimes are recomputed.

name: studio_edit_set_frame_ratio
description: Set canvas frame ratio: 16:9 | 9:16 | 1:1 (affects export composition).

name: studio_edit_set_track_muted
description: Mute or unmute a timeline track (video/audio/text).

name: studio_edit_set_transition
description: Set or clear transitionOut on a clip (applies into the following clip on export). Types: none, crossfade, dipToBlack, dipToWhite, wipeLeft, wipeRight, wipeUp, slideLeft, zoomIn, blur.

name: studio_edit_split_clip
description: Split a clip at a timeline timeSec (must fall inside the clip).

name: studio_edit_update_clips
description: [preferred] Patch clips by id: trimIn/trimOut, startTime, trackId, label, effects (volume/fades/speed/scale/x/y/rotation), transitionOut, text (text clips). Per-clip mute = effects.volume 0 — only when the user asks to mute; exports will be silent if volume is 0. Default leave volume unset/1 to keep source audio.

name: studio_element_sheet_guide
description: READ FIRST before character/prop/location sheets. Returns min/recommended reference photo counts, upload checklist, fidelity locks, output layout, and step-by-step MCP workflow.

name: studio_ensure_brief
description: Ensure an assisted production brief (creates a thread if needed). Does not run the chat co-pilot — set production knobs then approve when review_ready.

name: studio_ensure_path
description: [preferred] Create nested folders for a path in one call (e.g. Clients/JAV/refs). Case-insensitive reuse of existing segments. Prefer over repeated studio_create_folder. Requires write scope.

name: studio_estimate_batch
description: [preferred] Estimate total production budget for multiple generation items with contingency. Call before studio_generate_batch / cartoon budget approval. Alias: studio_estimate_production.

name: studio_estimate_generation
description: [preferred] Estimate credit cost before generating. Call before studio_generate_* or studio_generate_batch.

name: studio_estimate_production
description: Alias of studio_estimate_batch — estimate total production budget for multiple generation items with contingency. Call before studio_generate_batch / cartoon budget approval.

name: studio_explore_voices
description: Browse ElevenLabs voices for voiceover generation. Use voice_id as elevenVoiceId in studio_generate_audio.

name: studio_export_edit
description: Export a saved edit to a Studio asset (ffmpeg). Requires generate scope. Returns { assetId }. exportKind=video (default) or audio. Video: exportResolution 720p|1080p|4K (default 1080p). Audio: audioFormat mp3|wav|m4a (default mp3). Optional name overrides filename.

name: studio_fail_list_copy
description: Mark a failed Public catalog copy after studio_prepare_list_on_network (cleanup pending asset).

name: studio_fail_purchase_copy
description: Refund/void a purchase when Bunny copy fails after prepare-purchase.

name: studio_finalize_purchase_copy
description: Step 3 of purchase: finalize buyer asset after Bunny copy succeeded.

name: studio_folder_contents
description: List breadcrumb, subfolders, assets, documents, and elements in a folder. For a fuller pack use studio_project_context.

name: studio_follow
description: Follow a public profile by profileId.

name: studio_generate_audio
description: [preferred] Generate voiceover (TTS), SFX, or music and save to a folder. Call studio_estimate_generation with mode=audio first. Voiceover: requires elevenVoiceId (from studio_explore_voices or studio_list_saved_voices). Prompt = spoken text (max ~3000 chars). SFX: prompt = sound description; optional durationSeconds 0.5–30 (omit = Auto ~5s). Music: prompt = track description; durationSeconds 3–300 (default 30); forceInstrumental defaults true. Async by default (wait=false) then polls up to 3 min (music may need longer — raise wait or poll).

name: studio_generate_batch
description: [preferred] Queue multiple generations then poll until done. Prefer for props/shots packs after studio_estimate_batch. Rules: - Max 8 items per call. - Images/scripts/audio can run in parallel. - Videos are queued with ≥65s spacing (gateway 1 req/min). - Call studio_estimate_batch first for budget. - Inspect outputs with studio_view_media before another round. ${directHandoffHint}

name: studio_generate_element_sheet
description: Builds reference sheet image. Retired from Agent Mode.

name: studio_generate_element_text_sheet
description: Generates markdown production bible from reference photos. Retired from Agent Mode.

name: studio_generate_image
description: [preferred] Create an image from a prompt into a Studio folder (paid). Call studio_estimate_generation first when cost matters. wait=true. DEFAULT: Direct verbatim prompt; pass styleSheetElementId for enhancement sticking.

name: studio_generate_script
description: [preferred] Generate a script document in a folder. Call studio_estimate_generation with mode=script first. ${directHandoffHint}

name: studio_generate_video
description: [preferred] Generate a video and save it to a Studio folder. Call studio_estimate_generation first. Async + poll (up to 5 min). DEFAULT: Direct handoff (verbatim prompt). Pass styleSheetElementId to enable the enhancement sticking layer. VIDEO WITH PEOPLE (required workflow): 1. studio_generate_image — storyboard still with referenceElementIds 2. studio_generate_video — pass startFrameAssetId from step 1 + referenceElementIds for prop/location lock. Wait ≥65s between video calls (1 req/min gateway quota). For packs use studio_generate_batch. ${directHandoffHint}

name: studio_get_asset
description: Get asset metadata and signed read/thumbnail URLs (1h TTL).

name: studio_get_brief
description: Get an assisted brief by briefId, or by threadId (pass threadId only).

name: studio_get_document
description: Get a document by ID including markdown content.

name: studio_get_edit
description: Get a video edit project including project JSON (tracks/clips).

name: studio_get_element
description: Get an element by ID. Returns buildStatus, referenceAssetIds (upload refs), sheetAssetId/sheetUrl (built sheet).

name: studio_get_folder
description: Get a single folder by ID (name, parentId, icon).

name: studio_get_generation
description: Poll a generation job by ID. Returns status, prompts, model, settings, creditsSpent, and output assets.

name: studio_get_job
description: Get a marketplace job detail (events, deliverables, review eligibility).

name: studio_get_my_listing_detail
description: Seller listing detail with orders and unlist/release flags.

name: studio_get_my_listing_for_asset
description: Find the seller's listing row for a given assetId (if any).

name: studio_get_my_payout_account
description: Get the seller payout bank details (Settings → Payouts).

name: studio_get_my_profile
description: Get the authenticated API key owner's Studio public profile (username, bio, counts).

name: studio_get_my_seller_status
description: Get the API key owner's Creative Network seller application status (or null if never applied).

name: studio_get_network_listing
description: Get a single listed stock-audio listing card (preview URL, ownership).

name: studio_get_network_offer
description: Get a published Creative Network offer by slug (full gallery).

name: studio_get_payment
description: Get one payment by id (includes receipt URL when available). Requires read scope.

name: studio_get_post_media
description: Get signed thumbnail/media URLs for a public post.

name: studio_get_pricing
description: Credit unit price and sample generation credit costs. Requires read scope.

name: studio_get_profile
description: Get a public profile by username (includes isFollowing / isOwner for the API key user).

name: studio_get_storage
description: Storage usage, projected monthly charge (TTD), outstanding balance, and upload-block status. Requires read scope.

name: studio_get_subscription
description: Credit balance plus active subscription summary (plan name, period, included credits). Requires read scope. Prefer studio_credit_balance for balance-only.

name: studio_get_thread_history
description: Get chat/generation event history for a thread (prompts, stages, job/asset ids). Paginate with beforeOrder from nextBeforeOrder.

name: studio_health
description: Validate API key and return account info plus credit balance. Prefer studio_bootstrap at session start (includes this + tree + hints).

name: studio_is_approved_seller
description: Check whether a userId is an approved Creative Network seller.

name: studio_is_asset_shared
description: Check whether an asset is currently shared on the owner's profile.

name: studio_list_comment_replies
description: List replies under a parent comment.

name: studio_list_comments
description: List top-level comments on a public post.

name: studio_list_conversations
description: List DM conversations (newest first). Optional labelId filters to peers in that label. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_list_credit_transactions
description: Paginated credit ledger (spends, grants, refunds, storage charges). Pass continueCursor as cursor for the next page. Requires read scope.

name: studio_list_dm_labels
description: List the caller's DM labels (lists). Requires messages scope.

name: studio_list_edits
description: List video edit projects in a folder (defaults to API key sandbox).

name: studio_list_elements
description: List creative elements (characters, props, locations, docs). Filter by folderId or type.

name: studio_list_feed
description: List ranked feed posts (forYou or following). Viewer like/save state included.

name: studio_list_folders
description: List child folders one level deep. For orientation prefer studio_bootstrap / studio_workspace_tree / studio_search.

name: studio_list_generations
description: List recent generation jobs with status and output assets.

name: studio_list_jobs_with_peer
description: Jobs between the viewer and a peer (DM sidebar). Returns asBuyer / asSeller / sellerTotals.

name: studio_list_messages
description: List messages in a conversation (oldest → newest). Optional limit (default 120, max 200). Requires messages scope.

name: studio_list_my_buyer_jobs
description: List jobs where the API key owner is the buyer.

name: studio_list_my_collection
description: List the owner's saved, liked, or shared collection posts.

name: studio_list_my_following
description: List profiles the API key owner follows.

name: studio_list_my_listings
description: List the seller's stock-audio listings (manage pane).

name: studio_list_my_offers
description: List the seller's own Creative Network offers (all statuses). Requires approved seller.

name: studio_list_my_seller_jobs
description: List jobs where the API key owner is the seller. Optional offerId filter.

name: studio_list_my_shared_asset_ids
description: List asset IDs currently shared on the owner's public profile.

name: studio_list_network_offers
description: List published Creative Network offers (public catalog). Optional category filter.

name: studio_list_network_offers_by_username
description: List published offers for a seller username (Hire Me / profile).

name: studio_list_notifications
description: List in-app notifications (generation completed/failed, payment status). Requires social scope.

name: studio_list_offer_reviews
description: List verified-purchase reviews for a published offer.

name: studio_list_on_network
description: List owned stock audio on Creative Network (prepare → Bunny copy → commit). Requires approved seller.

name: studio_list_payments
description: List recent top-up / payment history for this account (up to 50). Requires read scope.

name: studio_list_peer_labels
description: List which of the caller's labels are assigned to a peer. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_list_peer_notes
description: List private notes about a peer. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_list_pending_approvals
description: List pending review_ready briefs and workspace side-effect approvals.

name: studio_list_platform_people
description: List public profiles the owner does not follow (people directory).

name: studio_list_presets
description: [deprecated] Style Sheets replaced presets. Returns Direct/unstyled only — use studio_list_style_sheets for styled work.

name: studio_list_public_posts
description: List public posts for a username (profile grid).

name: studio_list_reference_intents
description: List referenceIntent values for styled/Direct generation (auto, stylize, match_reference, element_lock).

name: studio_list_saved_voices
description: List Studio favorite voices for this API key owner.

name: studio_list_script_types
description: List script output types for studio_generate_script (production, storyboard, vo_script, etc.).

name: studio_list_style_sheets
description: [preferred] List Style Sheet elements (drafts + built). Styled generation needs styleRules and/or built sheetAssetId.

name: studio_list_subscription_plans
description: List enabled subscription plans (catalog). Requires read scope.

name: studio_list_text_presets
description: [preferred] List CapCut-like built-in text style templates (Grease, Dark Pill, etc.). Use studio_edit_apply_text_preset to apply. Filter by category: title | pop | soft | neon | badge | all.

name: studio_list_threads
description: List recent generation/assistance threads (id, title, folderId, updatedAt). Use before studio_get_thread_history.

name: studio_list_trash
description: List soft-deleted folders, assets, documents, and elements.

name: studio_list_video_models
description: List Studio video models (Seedance 2.5 / 2.0).

name: studio_mark_conversation_read
description: Mark a DM conversation as read (advances read + delivery watermarks). Requires messages scope.

name: studio_mark_notification_read
description: Mark a single notification as read. Requires social scope.

name: studio_my_asset_store_summary
description: Seller asset-store summary: listed/pending counts and funds (TTD cents).

name: studio_network_hire_label
description: Whether a username has hireable published offers; returns Hire Me / Hire Us label or null.

name: studio_open_conversation
description: Open or create a DM conversation with a public profile username. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_patch_brief_production
description: Patch production knobs on a brief (aspectRatio, duration, resolution, etc.). Requires expectedRevision for optimistic concurrency.

name: studio_peer_panel
description: DM peer sidebar payload: profile, seller tag, labels, block state. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_prepare_list_on_network
description: Step 1 of listing stock audio: prepare Public catalog copy paths. Prefer studio_list_on_network for the full pipeline. On copy failure call studio_fail_list_copy.

name: studio_prepare_purchase_listing
description: Step 1 of purchase: debit/escrow + return copy paths. Prefer studio_purchase_network_listing for the full pipeline.

name: studio_prepare_seller_doc_upload
description: Get a Convex staging upload URL for a seller KYC document. Upload the file to uploadUrl, then studio_commit_seller_doc_upload.

name: studio_production_guide
description: READ FIRST for character/prop/location pipelines. Explains unbuilt vs built states, when to use sheet vs upload refs, and direct-prompt generation defaults (unstyled + skipPromptEnhancement — no Flash rewrite before Seedance).

name: studio_project_context
description: [preferred] One-shot project pack for a folder: breadcrumb, shallow tree, element summaries, active style sheet, recent generations, counts.

name: studio_pull_frame
description: [preferred] Extract one still from an open edit via ffmpeg (saved in sibling Pulled Frames folder). Pass timeSec for timeline playhead, or assetId + localTimeSec for a source. Then Read preferredViewUrl. For multi-frame pulls on a source clip, use studio_pull_frames instead.

name: studio_pull_frames
description: [preferred] Pull N stills from a source video between startSec and endSec (or exact timesSec). Saves Frame · *.jpg into a sibling Pulled Frames folder (not next to the clip). Returns preferredViewUrl per frame — Cursor Read those images. No edit project required. See MCP resource studio://guides/pull-frames. Uses generate+write scope.

name: studio_purchase_network_listing
description: Purchase a stock-audio listing (prepare → Bunny copy → finalize). Debits balance.

name: studio_quote_book_offer
description: Quote escrow price/credits to book an offer (optional packageIndex).

name: studio_quote_list_price
description: Quote whether an owned audio asset can be listed and at what price.

name: studio_record_post_view
description: Record a view on a public feed post.

name: studio_record_share
description: Record a share engagement on a public feed post (bumps shareCount).

name: studio_reject_brief
description: Reject / abandon an assisted brief. Requires write scope.

name: studio_release_listing_to_platform
description: Release a sold stock listing to the platform (future profits = platform). Seller only.

name: studio_remove_voice
description: Remove a saved voice favorite. Requires write scope.

name: studio_request_seller_access
description: Submit Creative Network seller KYC application. Upload docs via prepare→commit first; pass returned bunnyPaths. Paths must be under users/{userId}/marketplace-kyc/.

name: studio_reserve_upload
description: Step 1 of two-step upload for large files. Returns { assetId, uploadUrl }. PUT/POST file bytes to uploadUrl, then call studio_complete_upload with the storageId from the upload response.

name: studio_resolve_path
description: [preferred] Resolve a Studio-relative folder path (e.g. Ads/JAV/scene-1) to folderId + breadcrumb. Does not create — use studio_ensure_path for that.

name: studio_restore
description: Restore a trashed folder, asset, document, or element. Requires write scope.

name: studio_sample_video_frames
description: [deprecated] Alias of studio_pull_frames. Prefer studio_pull_frames (startSec/endSec/count → Pulled Frames folder).

name: studio_save_my_payout_account
description: Save seller payout bank details. Requires an existing seller application/row.

name: studio_save_voice
description: Save a voice favorite for faster reuse. Requires write scope.

name: studio_search
description: [preferred] Search folders, assets, documents, and elements by name/title. Use before exploring blindly.

name: studio_search_messages
description: Unified DM sidebar search: people, chats, message bodies, and labels. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_send_image_message
description: Send an image DM using a billable Studio image asset (Messages folder). Optional caption + reply. Requires messages scope. For video or multi-file Choose/Share parity, use studio_send_media_message.

name: studio_send_media_message
description: Send Studio media in a DM (Choose/Share). Args: conversationId + assetId|assetIds. delivery=file (default) or access. Outbound — needs approval in Agent.

name: studio_send_message
description: Send a text DM. Args: {conversationId,body}. Optional replyToMessageId. Outbound — needs approval in Agent.

name: studio_send_voice_message
description: Send a voice DM using a billable Studio audio asset in the Messages folder. durationSec is client-measured length (1s–300s). Optional reply. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_set_active_style_sheet
description: MCP/API has no session store — pass styleSheetElementId on each studio_generate_image|video|script call for styled work (enhancement sticks style + context). Omit for Direct verbatim handoff.

name: studio_set_offer_status
description: Set offer status: draft | published | paused | archived. Requires approved seller.

name: studio_set_peer_labels
description: Replace which labels a peer belongs to (full set). Requires messages scope.

name: studio_share_asset_post
description: Post owned image/video to the public profile feed. Args: assetId, optional caption/hashtags. Use for post/share/publish — not advice.

name: studio_share_post_to_dm
description: Share a feed post (or comment) into a DM conversation. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_submit_job_review
description: Buyer leaves a 1–5 star review after a completed job (optional body).

name: studio_suggest_hashtags
description: Autocomplete hashtag suggestions for captions.

name: studio_suggest_people
description: Autocomplete @mention people suggestions.

name: studio_toggle_comment_like
description: Toggle like on a comment.

name: studio_toggle_like
description: Toggle like on a public feed post.

name: studio_toggle_save
description: Toggle save/bookmark on a public feed post.

name: studio_trash
description: Soft-delete one folder/asset/document/element. Args: {kind,id}. Destructive — needs approval in Agent.

name: studio_unblock_peer
description: Unblock a peer. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_unfollow
description: Unfollow a public profile by profileId.

name: studio_unlist_from_network
description: Unlist / withdraw a seller listing (no purchases). Does not delete the asset.

name: studio_unread_count
description: Count conversations with unseen inbound messages. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_unshare_post
description: Unshare a previously shared asset from the public profile (by assetId).

name: studio_update_asset
description: Rename an asset (image, video, audio) or move it to another folder. Requires write scope.

name: studio_update_dm_label
description: Rename or change icon on a DM label. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_update_document
description: Rename a document (title), replace full markdown content, or move it to another folder. For small inline edits prefer studio_patch_document (search/replace) to save tokens. Requires write scope.

name: studio_patch_document
description: Apply exact search/replace edit(s) to a document's markdown (coding-agent style). Prefer this over studio_update_document for small changes. Pass oldString+newString, or edits[{oldString,newString,replaceAll?}]. Fails if oldString missing or ambiguous (unless replaceAll). Requires write scope.

name: studio_update_edit
description: Save full project JSON (PUT) and/or rename/move (set name/folderId). Prefer granular studio_edit_* tools for clip ops. Pass project for full timeline replace when remove/append races or mute state is stuck. Open editor adopts newer Convex updatedAt automatically; verify with studio_get_edit then studio_export_edit.

name: studio_update_element
description: Update element name, description, or attached media (referenceAssetIds).

name: studio_update_folder
description: Rename a folder or move it under another parent. Requires write scope. Cannot move the API key sandbox root folder.

name: studio_update_my_profile
description: Update the owner's profile (bio, visibility, contact links, avatar, seller display name).

name: studio_update_offer
description: Update an owned Creative Network offer. Requires approved seller.

name: studio_update_peer_note
description: Update a private peer note by noteId. Requires messages scope.

name: studio_update_post_caption
description: Update the caption/description on an owned published post.

name: studio_upload_asset
description: Upload a reference photo or media file to a folder (inline base64, max 50MB). For larger files use studio_reserve_upload + studio_complete_upload. Requires write scope.

name: studio_validate_production_gates
description: Optional pre-flight gate check before studio_generate_* when using production-state.json (from archived cartoon-ad-production). Returns canProceed, blockers, warnings. Not required for Studio Assistance / direct gen.

name: studio_view_media
description: Return signed media URLs for the host client to view (e.g. Cursor Read on preferredViewUrl). Does NOT call Studio AI and uses no generation credits. Prefer thumbnailUrl/preferredViewUrl for images. For VIDEO stills before editing, use studio_pull_frames (Cursor cannot scrub MP4 via Read).

name: studio_workspace_tree
description: [preferred] Nested folder tree (paths + ids). Prefer over BFS studio_list_folders.
